[]` and then filters calendars by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId` (only the first destination calendar). With the diff changing `destinationCalendar` to an array and `handleNewBooking` appending additional team destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), creating events for a non-first destination/credential can result in `calendars.filter(...)` returning an empty list for that credential, leading to `Promise.all([])` and no event being created (effectively silently doing nothing). This is consistent with the finding and is directly verifiable from the filter logic in the diff.
